title: Canonical comparisons for vector-bundle Thom inputs
statement: In the finite purity setting [def-pur-conventions], for bundles and generator-normalized projections [def-pur-vector-bundle-zero-section], [def-pur-vector-bundle-thom-class], put $Q_X(r)=A_X(r)[2r]$, using the signed twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Each $Q_X(r)$ is bounded below and has etale origin. Define its canonical pullback by exact inverse image, its shift comparison and the root-normalized twist pullback. Define $Q_X(r)\otimes^L Q_X(s)\to Q_X(r+s)$ by the native derived single-complex tensor comparison, the ordinary root multiplication, and the even-shift comparison $2r+2s=2(r+s)$. These normalizations uniquely specify the maps; no scalar trivialization is chosen. For an arbitrary base change $g:B'\to B$ within the finite-type setting, define the compact-support comparison [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed] as proper/open exchange, followed by the preceding coefficient pullback and the normalized compactification comparison. A map of total spaces represents vector-bundle base change precisely when it is induced on symmetric-algebra generators by an isomorphism $g^*\mathcal M\cong\mathcal M'$. For a direct-sum identification $\mathcal M\cong\mathcal M_1\oplus\mathcal M_2$, the prescribed two projections give $E=E_1\times_B E_2$; the second projection is quasi-compact and compactifiable and its composite with $\pi_2$ equals $\pi$; this composite is compactifiable. The exterior input $L p_1^*Q_{E_1}(r)\otimes^L Lp_2^*Q_{E_2}(s)$ has bounded-below etale origin. Define its map to $Q_E(r+s)$ by the two preceding pullbacks followed by root multiplication. Also define the coefficient-postcomposed forward product for an arbitrary finite ring by the published forward product [lem-pur-finite-forward-product-symmetry], the equality of the structure maps, and compact direct image of the specified coefficient morphism, in that order. All constructions allow zero ranks, the empty base, and nonflat base change.
